notes: Cliopatria rows: the two shapes are identical (1,288 km2, 1015-1055 and 1056-1065); the row starts five years after the page's c. 1010 (the overview table says 1013) and stops a year before the conquest of 1066. Not settled (page silent): the founder, the extent of the taifa (no towns named), any war with Seville before 1066, and relations with the neighbouring Carmona and Arcos (the page mentions only Seville). The infobox gives no area. Mirror needed: Seville's gain of Morón in 1066. Gazetteer name needed: Morón de la Frontera (place, Sevilla province, 37.11 N 5.38 W).
